description: This file defines a React-like component called 'RecordsTable' using the 'Blits' framework. It renders a table for displaying General Ledger records with a header and scrollable rows, optimized for performance. The component includes methods for formatting monetary values and table cell contents.

classes.name: RecordsTable
classes.description: A component that renders a performant, scrollable table of ledger records with customizable columns and styling.

methods.name: formatMoney
methods.description: Formats a number as a monetary string with two decimal places, handling invalid inputs.

methods.name: formatCell
methods.description: Determines the display value for a cell, applying money formatting for specific keys.
